corrections.reason: In the printed Ge'ez text (Matt 18:14), the verb is spelled ይትኀጐል with 1st-order ኀ, not 4th-order ኃ.
The canonical cross-reference for church discipline is 2 Thessalonians 3:14 (፪ተሰሎ ፫ ፲፬), and the zoomed image shows the closed bottom loop of ፬.
In both the printed image and classical Ge'ez orthography of Matt 18:19, the verb is ኀብሩ with 1st-order ኀ.
In the printed Ge'ez text of Matt 18:20, the nominative plural participle is clearly printed as ጉቡዓን (with 6th-order ን) rather than ጉቡዓነ.
